config.sip.profile.connected: The account is connected. Check the remaining phone functions below.
config.sip.profile.restart_text: Restart AuraGo once so the browser phone can use the new audio settings.
config.sip.delete.title: Delete SIP profile?
config.sip.delete.text: This removes the account settings and the stored SIP password. It cannot be undone.
config.sip.diagnostic.dns_failed: The SIP server name could not be resolved. Check the provider or server address.
config.sip.diagnostic.unreachable: The SIP server is not reachable. Check the address, network, and router.
config.sip.diagnostic.authentication_fai: The SIP server rejected the login. Check the username and SIP password.
config.sip.diagnostic.rejected: The SIP server rejected the registration. Check whether this account permits another device.
config.sip.diagnostic.timeout: The SIP server did not respond in time. Check the network and try again.
config.sip.diagnostic.failed: The connection test failed. Review the account details and try again.
config.sip.wizard.calling_title: What calls should this phone allow?
config.sip.wizard.outbound_intro: Outgoing browser calls are enabled by default. Choose the range that suits this account.
config.sip.wizard.scope_all_desc: Allow every destination in this account's exact SIP domain.
config.sip.wizard.scope_domestic_desc: Allow national dialling and this provider's country code.
config.sip.wizard.scope_custom_desc: Allow only the numbers or extensions you enter.
config.sip.wizard.custom_targets_hint: Separate entries with commas. Patterns and technical wildcards remain available in Technical settings.
config.sip.wizard.custom_targets_require: Enter at least one allowed number or extension.
config.sip.wizard.inbound_enable_desc: Off by default. AuraGo detects the trusted phone-system addresses automatically when enabled.
config.sip.wizard.callers_all_desc: Accept every caller arriving from the detected phone system.
config.sip.wizard.callers_custom_desc: Accept only the caller numbers or extensions you enter.
config.sip.wizard.custom_callers_require: Enter at least one allowed caller.
config.sip.wizard.verify_check_title: AuraGo checks the setup for you
config.sip.wizard.verify_check_text: The profile is saved atomically, then AuraGo immediately tests registration. You stay here if anything needs attention.
config.sip.wizard.custom_value_invalid: “{value}” is not an individual number or extension.
config.sip.allowed_domains_help: Only exact domains are allowed; wildcards grant no access.
config.sip.allowed_users_help: Only exact SIP users are allowed; enter number ranges as E.164 prefixes.
config.sip.outbound_policy_migration_req: Wildcard outbound rules no longer grant access. Replace them with exact destinations before saving.
